hypotheses.rationale: WebSurfer misidentified Don Mueang International Airport in Bangkok, Thailand, as a hub for Lion Air. Lion Air's primary hub is Soekarno-Hatta International Airport in Jakarta, Indonesia. This error led Planner to conclude the wrong country (Thailand instead of Indonesia) and consequently the wrong former name (Siam instead of Dutch East Indies). Correcting this step would have prevented the incorrect final answer.
